micronesia.title: Flag of the Federated States of Micronesia

colors.note: United Nations-style blue representing the Pacific Ocean
Four five-pointed stars representing the federated states

desc:
- Light blue field with four white five-pointed stars arranged in a diamond pattern at the centre
- Adopted on 30 November 1978 when the four states ratified the constitution of the Federated States of Micronesia
trivia:
- The four stars represent the four states: Yap, Chuuk, Pohnpei, and Kosrae
- The design derives from the flag of the US Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands, with the number of stars reduced from six to four
- The UN-style light blue was chosen to acknowledge the Trust Territory's earlier UN administration
